probes: Existing fit_probe ridge=1 and score_probe on supplied coordinates, without rescaling. Shared fit row_weights: equal classes, vessels/class, acquisitions/vessel, chips/acquisition. Held OA and class recall are chip means; BA is mean recall of present classes. No checkpoint selection.
pairs: Mean chips within MMSI/product/port first; only distinct-product same-vessel pairs. all includes same-port and cross-port; cross_port requires different ports. Equal pairs/vessel, vessels/class, then covered classes. class_id=-1 is the aggregate.
energies: Uncentered coordinate-mean squared deltas in common source-whitened baseprior32. residual_delta_mse=E||delta_residual_component-delta_z||^2/32. Every paired ratio divides weighted mean numerator by actual weighted E||delta_z||^2/32 on the SAME cohort; no per-pair ratio averaging or denominator from another space. Explained fraction=1-residual_delta_mse_ratio, may be negative. content_delta_energy_ratio=E||delta_content_component||^2/E||delta_z||^2. full_reconstruction_delta_ratio uses delta_content+delta_residual-delta_z.
reconstruction: Full reconstruction ratio=weighted E||content_component+residual_component-z||^2/weighted E||z||^2, using role-local row_weights and uncentered z energy.
acquisition_input: Load exported selected model without training; run model(mean acquisition z). Compare with acquisition mean of exported model(chip z) components. acquisition_input_* metrics use the former, ordinary metrics the latter. Both use identical actual original z deltas and class/ship/pair weights. Jensen gap=model(mean z).residual-mean(model(z).residual). Delta RMS ratio is sqrt(E||gap_a-gap_b||^2/E||delta_z||^2). Endpoint RMS ratio is sqrt(E[(||gap_a||^2+||gap_b||^2)/2]/E||delta_z||^2), on the same covered pairs.
mechanical_identity: Orthogonal decoder components impose delta_content dot delta_residual=0. Let e=delta_content+delta_residual-delta_z. Residual delta error energy =content delta energy+||e||^2-2 delta_content dot e. Exact reconstruction therefore forces residual explained fraction=1-content delta energy ratio. These are not independent evidence of separation. partition_identity_gap is residual error ratio minus content energy ratio; approximate reconstruction can change it. No fixed physical axes or causal factors are identified.
selected_readout: Selected checkpoint content head applied to exported c7; compare its held OA/BA with the independent sourcefit ridge probe. No additional model selection.
summary: Arithmetic mean of two full-model seed metrics on test_source only. Defined-seed counts expose zero-denominator or absent-class results; coverage counts are unique cohort counts, never summed across seeds or methods.
matched_control: Reused existing held-source class-matched other-vessel exact donor product/port cohort. Chip anchor versus acquisition-mean donors; equal matched donors/anchor then row_weights over covered anchors. Ratio of weighted mean squared same/other distances.
limitations: Observational separation diagnostics, not causal identification. Residual class readability is not expected to be zero. Coverage is class dependent; zero coverage is not zero drift. No validation or target metrics, architecture comparisons, or neural training.
